dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Go look for some reference books first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... theory is the safest way to get started.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius' library has a large collection of books. You should be able to find something there, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Liyue and Inazuma also have knowledge on arranging flowers. If you get the chance, you can also try to get some books written there for reference.

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: I understand. I'll ask someone to help me get some books from the library once Weinlesefest ends.

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: As for reference books from Liyue and Inazuma, I should be able to ask Mats. He travels a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, maybe the next time we meet, you'll have become a master at arranging flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: I'll do my best. Your suggestions are really valuable. Thank you very much!

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: Here is a token of my gratitude. Please take it!
